note: Noumenia — the new moon opens the month. The household gods are honoured, along with Selene and Apollo Noumenios.
Day of Agathos Daimon, the good spirit of the house.
Day of Aphrodite and Hermes (also of Eros and Heracles).
Day of Poseidon (and of the hero Theseus).
Deipnon — the last day of the month (dark moon). Hekate’s Supper at the crossroads and the cleaning of the house close the lunar cycle.
